verdict.rationale: The only evidence of an in-product delegation flow is the homepage's guided fine-tuning path: the user describes a task, reviews a plan and cost, approves the run, and gets a trained model. That implies a built-in, plan-and-approve assistant, but it is limited to training and described in a single marketing line. Tool calling and Nexus CLI are developer building blocks or external-tool connectors, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a built-in AI assistant, scope beyond fine-tuning, docs on how delegation and approval work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe the task, review the plan and cost, approve the run, and get a trained model.
